title: 第一卷 第19章 死了一了百了赢了发笔大财第一卷 第20章 你好像没我想象的那么强
content_zh:
“怂货！”
顾尘怒骂了一句，暗道你刚刚发情时的那股癫狂劲，抢丹药时的那股蛮横劲去哪了？
差一点。
要不是还惦记着老头子成亲以后的幸福日子，他几乎还想把那瓶合欢丹塞进对方嘴里了！
“吼！”
九骨蜥低吼反驳，有点底气不足。
他们太厉害！
而且两个打四个，完全打不过！
顾尘气笑了。
“怕个屁！”
他毫不客气地教训道：“你认怂他们就会放过你了？他们就不扒你的皮，不抽你的筋，不吃你的肉，不喝你的血，不拿你的骨头去泡酒了？”
九骨蜥一脸惊恐地看着他。
你怎么这么熟悉流程？
顾尘很低调，并没有暴露自己紫云村第一猎手的身份，语重心长，又加了把火！
“相信我！”
“你要是死了，你的尸体会被他们利用到极致！”
最后这句话，听得九骨蜥心里发麻，那股怂劲儿瞬间没了大半！
它灵智低。
可终究不是那些个只凭本能行事的野兽，也明白认怂只有死路一条的道理。
“吼！！”

一发狠，它又是窜到了顾尘身旁，与之并肩！
“就该这样！”
顾尘很满意它的表现，又是看向几人，恶声恶气道：“他们想要咱们的命，咱们就要他们的命……死了一了百了！赢了就发大财！”
九骨蜥眼睛一亮，顿时盯上了四人的储物袋！
“吼~！”
这次怎么分？
“我吃个亏！”
为了给这怂货一点动力，顾尘咬牙道：“你三个我一个！”
刷刷！
沉默了半瞬，九骨蜥忽而踏前两步，将顾尘护在了身前！
见一人一兽配合如此娴熟，那瘦高青年三人顿时皱起了眉头。
惯犯！
肯定是惯犯！
反倒是吴良，虽然也有些惊讶，可依旧是一副从从容容，游刃有余的模样。
“想不到。”
“我五家在紫云城也有些名气，到头来竟然栽在了一只孽畜，一个卑贱的野修手里。”
看着挡在顾尘身前的大块头，他淡淡吩咐道：“这个孽障交给你们三个了！四阶妖兽，倒也浑身是宝，将它抽筋扒皮，剔骨去肉，取下晶核……物尽其用，也算是弥补一点损失了！”
“吼！！！”
九骨蜥暴怒。
content_en:
"Coward!"
Gu Chen cursed angrily and thought to himself, where did your crazy energy when you were in heat and your arrogant energy when you were grabbing the pill go?
Not even close.
If he hadn't been thinking about the old man's happy days after getting married, he would have almost wanted to stuff the bottle of Albizia Julibrissin into his mouth!
"Roar!"
The nine-bone lizard retorted with a low growl, somewhat lacking in confidence.
They are so awesome!
And two against four, you can't beat them at all!
Gu Chen laughed angrily.
"Afraid of shit!"
He lectured unceremoniously: "They will let you go if you give in? They won't peel off your skin, beat your tendons, eat your flesh, drink your blood, or use your bones to make wine?"
The Nine-Bone Lizard looked at him in horror.
How come you are so familiar with the process?
Gu Chen was very low-key and did not reveal his identity as the number one hunter in Ziyun Village. He spoke seriously and added fire!
"Trust me!"
"If you die, your body will be used to the extreme by them!"
The last words made the Nine Bone Lizard feel numb in his heart, and most of his timidity disappeared instantly!
It has low intelligence.
But after all, they are not those beasts who only act on instinct, and they also understand that giving in will only lead to death.
"Roar!!"
With a fierce move, it rushed to Gu Chen's side again, shoulder to shoulder with him!
"That's how it should be!"
Gu Chen was very satisfied with its performance. He looked at the others again and said angrily: "They want our lives, we want their lives... A hundred people have died! If we win, we will make a fortune!"
The Nine-Bone Lizard's eyes lit up and he immediately stared at the four people's storage bags!
"Ho~!"
How to divide it this time?
"I'll suffer a loss!"
In order to give this coward some motivation, Gu Chen gritted his teeth and said, "You three and I'll take one!"
Swish!
After being silent for a moment, the Nine Bone Lizard suddenly took two steps forward and protected Gu Chen in front of him!
Seeing how well one man and one beast cooperated, the three tall and thin young men suddenly frowned.
recidivist!
Must be a repeat offender!
Wu Liang, on the other hand, although he was a little surprised, he still looked calm and at ease.
"Unexpected."
"My five families are also somewhat famous in Ziyun City, but in the end they fell into the hands of an evil beast, a despicable wild cultivator."
Looking at the big man standing in front of Gu Chen, he calmly ordered: "I'll leave this evil obstacle to you three! The fourth-level monster is actually full of treasures. I peeled off its muscles, skinned it, removed its bones and flesh, removed its crystal core... put everything to good use, and I can make up for some of the losses!"
"Roar!!!"
The nine-bone lizard was furious.
